rationale: Ground truth has no substantive concerns (only approvals/thanks), so recall is trivially satisfied by both. Candidate X does solid code-grounded verification but terminates in an empty, contentless 'nit' line with no actual comment, leaving nothing actionable despite claiming a finding exists. Candidate Y produces four specific, line-referenced findings grounded in the actual diff text — including catching that the new doc's own 'silent audio' claim is technically inaccurate (traces to a 500 error instead) and that the extra_body rule is overstated relative to a sibling recipe — each with concrete rewording or verification-command suggestions.
